name: geo-seo-plugin
description: Get a site found, cited and recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google (GEO, AEO, AI visibility, SEO). Leads with a field-tested Answer Library playbook for new products, then JSON-LD schema stacks, metadata, sitemap and robots, llms.txt, and AI-citation content rules grounded in the Princeton GEO Study, Muck Rack Generative Pulse, Averi and Foglift citation benchmarks, and Google's guidance. Ships a zero-dependency audit script.
